show.description: A broken woman, robbed of motherhood, finds unexpected love in a humble construction worker—unaware he’s a secret billionaire hiding his true identity. As their fragile romance deepens, dark secrets, betrayal, and a stolen child resurface, forcing them to fight against fate, enemies, and shattered trust to claim the family they were destined for.
